Model performance

Benchmarks, learning curve, aspect scores

Scores on 232 gold reviews that the models never saw during training.

All scores use the untouched 232-review test set. Across all 12 aspects, TF-IDF is slightly ahead on exact aspect + sentiment F1 (0.494 vs XLM-R 0.481). Without Overall, XLM-R leads (0.481 vs 0.451). MuRIL learned after class-weighted training, but scored lower and varied more across seeds (0.323 ± 0.092).

More labelled data, better scores

TF-IDF aspect + sentiment F1 rises from 0.30 with 98 training reviews to 0.49 with 786, with smaller gains as the dataset grows.

Search examples, compare team labels and model output

Pick a review to see the team's labels, the model's prediction, the words that drove it, and similar past reviews.

ReviewSaar · Research prototype for aspect-based sentiment analysis of Hinglish e-commerce reviews. Existing benchmarks use TF-IDF + Logistic Regression, XLM-R, and MuRIL. New reviews use the trained model when its API and checkpoint are available; otherwise the dashboard labels its output as an offline keyword estimate. Results are for exploration and should be reviewed before business decisions.
